563:t_022:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This is $$ガンバスター$$, transformed into a blazing flame!」

563:t_022:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It's an invincible power that protects humanity!」

563:t_022:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I kept you waiting, $$ノリコ$$.」

563:t_022:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「No! Now that I'm with you again, Big Sis, I've forgotten all the sadness and pain!」

563:t_022:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Your Big Sis... Isn't she already an old la...」

563:t_022:9.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Hehe... From your perspective, I suppose it would be fair to call me an old lady.」

563:t_022:10.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But my body now is the one I had when I first piloted $$ガンバスター$$ with $$ノリコ$$.」

563:t_022:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes! Big Sis looks exactly like she did when everyone called her the $$バラの女王$$!」

563:t_022:14.en:
$$カズミ$$
「After the black hole swallowed me and threw me out of $$ガンバスター$$, I wished to see $$ノリコ$$ again... To fight alongside her...」

563:t_022:15.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And that wish crossed space and time, giving my body a new life.」

563:t_022:16.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The $$バスター軍団$$ answered your wish and went to bring you back, Miss Big Sis!」

563:t_022:17.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The $$バスター軍団$$ answered your wish and went to bring you back, Miss Big Sis!」

563:t_022:18.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「The $$バスター軍団$$ answered your wish and went to bring you back, Miss Big Sis!」

563:t_022:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This truly is a mystery of the universe!」

563:t_022:20.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... Even after living so long, I've had plenty of surprises lately.」

563:t_022:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This is a miracle brought about by Big Sis's wish!」

563:t_022:23.en:
$$オルソン$$
「A human will controlled events...?」

563:t_022:24.en:
$$桂$$
「That's great! I'll gladly welcome something like that!」

563:t_022:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Big Sis... You'll fight alongside $$ノリコ$$ again, won't you?」

563:t_022:27.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then let's go! You too, $$ラルク$$!」

563:t_023:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now that Big Sis and I are together, we have nothing to fear!」

563:t_023:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And wherever we are, there's only one thing for us to do!」

563:t_023:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$'s blazing flame is the hope that protects humanity!」

563:t_023:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Beautiful long hair, a gorgeous body, and the smile of a holy mother... That's...)

563:t_023:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(Beautiful long hair, a gorgeous body, and the smile of a holy mother... That's...)

563:t_023:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(Beautiful long hair, a gorgeous body, and the smile of a holy mother... That's...)

563:t_024:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「No... It's the beginning of a new battle for Big Sis and me.」

563:t_025:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...It's ridiculous... For something so convenient to happen...」

563:t_025:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「What a rigid-minded boy. You're just like a dull grown-up.」

563:t_025:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... I do understand how you feel. But we all have to grow up someday.」

563:t_025:9.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Do you really think some platitude will convince me?」

563:t_025:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Coming from someone with your power, it just sounds like you're rubbing it in.」

563:t_025:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Even if my $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities have declined since I was sixteen?」

563:t_025:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I can feel it, vaguely. It's probably because I've picked up too much baggage to see what's in front of me honestly.」

563:t_025:14.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You mean... because you've grown up?」

563:t_025:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I'm proud to say I'm much stronger now than I was then.」

563:t_025:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「Yes. I can vouch for that.」

563:t_025:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Even if you're no longer a $$トップレス$$, you're still you.」

563:t_025:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you have the will to fight, there must be plenty of ways for you to grow stronger.」

563:t_025:19.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...You're still an outsider. You don't understand anything about being a $$トップレス$$.」

563:t_025:21.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But my pride won't let me end up a loser like this.」

563:t_025:23.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Don't worry, Princess. I'll never give in to despair again.」

563:t_025:24.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Maybe I'll get a miracle like $$ノリコ$$'s Big Sis did.」

563:t_025:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't forget, $$ニコラ$$. Miracles don't just happen. You make them happen.」

563:t_025:26.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even those words are some comfort to me now.」

563:t_025:27.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If you're cracking jokes again, we don't have to worry anymore.」

563:t_025:28.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「If you're cracking jokes again, we don't have to worry anymore.」

563:t_025:29.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「If you're cracking jokes again, we don't have to worry anymore.」

563:t_025:34.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm sorry. Please forget what happened today.」

563:t_025:38.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm not sure I follow, but it looks like that's settled.」

563:t_025:40.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Good work, $$ラルク$$. I saw your hard work and guts for myself.」

563:t_025:41.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It wasn't that... It's just... $$ディスヌフ$$ told me to help you...」

563:t_025:42.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm still glad you did... Thank you, $$ラルク$$.」
